<?php
// Test-only: feed the Spotify show sync a fixed set of episodes so the suite
// never calls the real Spotify API. Uses the ss_spotify_episodes extension
// point the sync exposes.
add_filter( 'ss_spotify_episodes', function( $stub, $show_id ) {
    if ( $show_id !== 'TESTSHOW00000000000000' ) return $stub;
    return [
        [ 'id' => 'TESTEPISODE00000000001', 'name' => 'Stub Episode One', 'description' => 'First stub episode.', 'release_date' => '2019-05-01', 'images' => [ [ 'url' => 'https://i.scdn.co/image/stub-art-640-one', 'width' => 640 ], [ 'url' => 'https://i.scdn.co/image/stub-art-300-one', 'width' => 300 ] ] ],
        [ 'id' => 'TESTEPISODE00000000002', 'name' => 'Stub Episode Two', 'description' => 'Second stub episode.', 'release_date' => '2019-05-08', 'images' => [ [ 'url' => 'https://i.scdn.co/image/stub-art-300-two', 'width' => 300 ] ] ],
    ];
}, 10, 2 );

<?php
// Test-only: answer Sermon Shots API calls locally so the suite never needs a
// real key or the network. Video 424242 has a Markdown discussion guide (the
// shape Sermon Shots really returns); 500500 errors.
add_filter( 'pre_option_sermon_suite_shots_api_key', function () { return 'test-shots-key'; } );
add_filter( 'pre_http_request', function ( $pre, $args, $url ) {
    if ( strpos( $url, 'https://api.sermonshots.com/' ) !== 0 ) return $pre;
    $reply = function ( $code, $body ) {
        return [ 'headers' => [], 'body' => $body, 'response' => [ 'code' => $code, 'message' => '' ], 'cookies' => [], 'filename' => null ];
    };
    if ( strpos( $url, '/video/424242/discussion-guide' ) !== false ) {
        return $reply( 200, wp_json_encode( [ 'content' => "## Talk It Over\n\n1. Stub question one?\n2. Stub question **two**?" ] ) );
    }
    if ( strpos( $url, '/video/500500/' ) !== false ) return $reply( 500, '{"error":"boom"}' );
    return $reply( 200, '[]' );
}, 10, 3 );
